## Changes

- Keep a manual subtitle “Off” selection through track refreshes and source changes instead of reselecting the preferred embedded subtitle.
- Clear and hide existing subtitle cues when subtitles are switched off; restore the subtitle view when a track is selected again.
- Cancel pending ALASS alignment when subtitles are off, and stop subtitle-download work at its next cancellation check.

## Verification And Limitations

Local Android unit tests and release lint passed. Physical TV playback and subtitle switching still need on-device verification.
